title: Selection Center no-HMM package selection is blocked by Paper runtime-profile trading gate
description: Expected: Selection and Paper/MiniQMT simulation are separate product branches. A newly created valid StrategyPackage should be able to run basic Selection Center stock selection with HMM disabled without requiring the operator to manually activate a Paper/MiniQMT runtime profile. The program should create or classify the correct auditable selection runtime context, while keeping Paper/MiniQMT execution authorization separately gated by execution-specific versioning. Actual: a newly created StrategyPackage selection run can fail with STRATEGY_PACKAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR: runtime_config changes trading behavior without a versioned runtime profile activation because the default frontend selection request serializes behavior-changing runtime_config fields and the backend applies the execution-profile gate at the standalone selection step.
reproduce_command: Create or select a valid StrategyPackage such as qe_20260520_215627_abbc, open /paper-v2/selection, leave HMM disabled, run selection, and observe STRATEGY_PACKAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR: runtime_config changes trading behavior without a versioned runtime profile activation.
required_verification: Newly created valid StrategyPackage can run Selection Center with HMM disabled without manual Paper/MiniQMT runtime profile activation.
Selection runtime context is generated or classified programmatically and remains auditable.
Selection evidence/artifacts remain separate from Paper/MiniQMT execution authorization.
Paper/MiniQMT execution paths still require proper versioned runtime activation before orders, ledger, cash, holdings, NAV, or simulated execution can be affected.
Regression coverage includes default frontend runtime_config with HMM disabled and proves the low-level runtime profile activation error is not exposed for basic selection.
closure_requirements: Selection Center and Paper/MiniQMT execution branch boundaries are explicit in code and tests.
Basic selection is not blocked by execution-profile requirements that belong only to Paper/MiniQMT activation.
The fix does not weaken BUG-086 runtime behavior-change protections on execution paths.

events.note: User clarified that selection and simulation are separate branches and simulation gates must not block basic selection. Registered GitHub issue and local BUG JSON with direct linkage; no code fix performed.
